cat.heading: TDGR 289C. Research Seminar (6)
cat.text: This course will support students in developing their dissertation. Throughout the quarter and aided by readings (both theoretical and methodological), students will produce drafts of dissertation chapters and receive regular feedback from their peers and the instructor. Prerequisites: admission to PhD program in theatre.

cat.heading: TDGR 289D. Professionalization Seminar (6)
cat.text: This course will support students in developing the skills they need to pursue a career beyond the PhD. Throughout the quarter and with the aid of readings (both theoretical and methodological) and guest visits, students will prepare materials for conferences, fellowships, job and grant applications, as well as publications. They will receive regular feedback from peers and the instructor. Prerequisites: admission to PhD program in theatre.
